name: TestcaseObject
summary: Represents one test as an object, so that a test can be passed around, held in a collection and run later.

roles.name: TestcaseObject
roles.summary: One test, reified — the command object a suite holds. It is what lets a suite be built at run time rather than written out, and it is why a test can be counted, filtered and re-run without the framework parsing anything.
